name: Reliability Estimator Selection

selected_candidate.estimator: Firth logistic regression with FLIC intercept correction

primary_benchmark.purpose: Determine whether downstream uncertainty contributes useful reliability information beyond upstream evidence readiness.

selection_rationale: M_EU is carried forward because it preserves the strong upstream evidence-readiness signal, incorporates the downstream uncertainty signals required by the research question, and provides the strongest overall development-stage point estimates across probabilistic accuracy, calibration and discrimination. The incremental advantage over M_E remains uncertain for Brier score and AUPRC under scenario-level bootstrap, so superiority is not treated as established.
interpretation_constraints: Selection is based only on frozen development out-of-fold evidence.
The final holdout has not been used to make this selection.
M_EU is not claimed to be conclusively superior to M_E.
M_E remains the primary benchmark for evaluating incremental downstream uncertainty value.
No reliability policy threshold is selected at this stage.
